signature_length_bytes.meaning: length in bytes of the UserOperation signature held by the relayer
signature_length_bytes.checkpoint: before relayer rewrites the time-window suffix

time_window_suffix_bytes.meaning: length in bytes of the trailing validUntil/validAfter time-window suffix of the signature
time_window_suffix_bytes.checkpoint: before relayer rewrites the time-window suffix

hash_excludes_signature.meaning: getUserOpHash hashes the UserOperation excluding the signature field, so changing the trailing suffix bytes leaves userOpHash unchanged
hash_excludes_signature.checkpoint: before relayer rewrites the time-window suffix

window_authenticated_by_owner.meaning: the validUntil/validAfter time window is covered by the owner's signature so a relayer cannot alter it without invalidating the signature
window_authenticated_by_owner.checkpoint: at signature validation of the submitted operation

unauthorized_wallet_action_executed.meaning: AtomWallet.execute performs an attacker-chosen call (token transfer, approval, or other wallet action) at an attacker-chosen time without the signer's authorization
unauthorized_wallet_action_executed.checkpoint: after submission of the modified UserOperation

assumptions: The relayer/bundler is an unauthorized party relative to the signer's time-window intent; the report does not state whether relayers are permissionless or specifically authorized.
The rewritten operation's actual execution depends on EntryPoint validation and bundling not described in the report.
Impacts are potential; no concrete executed transaction or observed loss amount is reported.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the relayer is permissionless or specifically authorized; the protected-action condition is limited to holders of a valid signed operation.
Whether the rewritten operation actually executes depends on EntryPoint validation and bundling not described in the report; the execution outcome cannot be bound from supplied statements.

limitations: The impact is potential; the plan encodes the forbidden unauthorized wallet action as an observable Boolean rather than a concrete executed transfer or approval amount.
The time-window values validUntil/validAfter are not given concrete literals; only the 12-byte suffix length is bound.
Authorization scope is narrowed to the reported scenario of a relayer holding a valid 77-byte signed operation.
